recap:
## Decisions
- Case will be latex over a hard inner shell, likely in fruit/vegetable colours [00:31:20]
- Case will be curved of some sort [00:31:44]
- Buttons will be pushbuttons rather than a scroll wheel, to keep costs down [00:33:14]
- A menu button will open an on-screen TV menu that users scroll through [00:33:39]
- Buttons: on/off, volume, favourite channels and menu, with no number buttons [00:34:10]
- Simple chip [00:34:41]

## Action items
- ID: Share pictures of the curved and double-curved case options once received [00:07:14]
- ID: Investigate the specific case materials [00:05:39]
- ME: Pass on any further information about the fruit-and-vegetable trend [00:25:41]
- owner not assigned: Look and feel design, user interface design, product evaluation (each member has one, but the transcript doesn't say who does which) [00:34:26]
- owner not assigned: Build a modelling-clay prototype ("you two," not identified) [00:34:31]

## Unresolved
- Kinetic battery was favoured but not formally decided; cost and reliability still need checking [00:27:09]
- Difference between curved and double-curved cases is unknown [00:31:40]
- Pushbuttons were chosen "unless we get any information"; the scroll wheel's cost is unknown [00:32:38]
- ME questioned whether the research ranking (fashion above ease of use) is reliable [00:20:18]
- Changeable covers, fruit-shaped buttons and lemon-peel packaging were floated but not agreed [00:26:09]
- Whether the volume control doubles as the up/down button for menus wasn't confirmed [00:34:16]
